source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
A **TRANSPORT** model's datasheet gives its **transport capacity**: which friendly models may embark in it, and how many. Several units can be embarked in one at once if capacity allows.

When declaring battle formations, a unit can start embarked in any friendly **TRANSPORT** model with enough capacity left for the whole unit.

Every **DEDICATED TRANSPORT** model you field needs a unit of yours embarked in it; at the end of that step, any without one is **destroyed**, and its destruction triggers no rules.
